# Virto Commerce

> > Enterprise B2B e-commerce platform built on MACH architecture, offering composable solutions for automotive, marketplace, and industrial businesses.

Virto Commerce provides a headless, API-first e-commerce platform with features like secure authentication (SSO, 2FA), automated invoicing, and industry-specific solutions. The platform supports complex B2B scenarios including digital catalogs, aftermarket parts distribution, and multi-vendor marketplaces.

## Key Topics

- MACH Architecture
- B2B E-commerce Platform
- Composable Commerce
- Automotive & Auto Parts Solutions
- Marketplace & Aftermarket
- Single Sign-On (SSO) & Azure AD
- Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
- Automated Invoicing
- Digital Catalog Management
- Headless Commerce
- API-First Platform
- Enterprise Security & Compliance
- Spare Parts Distribution
- Agile Development

- [Secure your ecommerce platform with multiple authentication methods.](https://virtocommerce.com/features/secure-user-authentication): Authentication features: SSO via Azure AD/Google, 2FA for secure access
- [Automated Invoicing | Virto Commerce](https://virtocommerce.com/features/invoicing): Automated invoicing feature for B2B/B2C order processing and compliance
